label: Exploratory V5 range/damage forward-Seam-Pin candidate B2
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, or reward authority.
It keeps Candidate A's level-ground ideal-direct-hit range/damage projection so the only comparison variable is an explicitly configured Needlepoint forward-stitch tactical-core hypothesis.

Needlepoint may be cast while stationary for low ideal direct damage, but only a cast whose movement reduces separation applies the one-target-turn Seam Pin; that tether caps the target's distance-increasing movement at 32 units while still permitting a cast, hold, or move toward the caster.

A Needlepoint cast whose movement increases separation is unavailable. Fire still ends the caster's turn; no post-shot movement, terrain, aim, splash, animation, or production counter-effect is modelled.
The caster cannot apply another Seam Pin on their immediately following turn.
